notes.title: Update 0.5 "The Canyon Purge" Now Available in SCP: The Expedition
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update 0.5 "The Canyon Purge"[/b] Now Available in [b]SCP: The Expedition[/b][/h1]
[h3]We are thrilled to announce the release of [b]update 0.5 "The Canyon Purge"[/b] for [b]SCP: The Expedition[/b]. This update focuses on a new chilling threat from [b]SCP-337[/b], and the introduction of the game’s first side mission centered on eradicating these monstrous entities from the canyon. Here’s what’s new:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/41bdb8d7b7bba3167b8ee9121b3884d04066c692.gif[/img]

[h2]Main Feature - [b]SCP-337[/b] and the Canyon Mission: [/h2]
After dealing with the Chaos Insurgency in Act 2, the area has become infested with SCP-337! Players must take on the daunting task of defeating these monsters and destroying their spore nests to clear the canyon and restore safety to the region.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/435e4f3163cea1c2b0e8f8bfc553977af808b6ed.gif[/img]

[h2]Other Gameplay Improvements:[/h2]
[h3][b]Automated Item Sorting: [/b][/h3]
We’ve added a feature that automatically sorts items by their usefulness, making inventory management easier and more intuitive.

[h3][b]Inventory Screen Dragging Fix: [/b][/h3]
We’ve fixed the issue where the inventory screen would move unintentionally while dragging items, ensuring a smoother interface interaction.

[h3][b]Modified Combat Encounter in Act 2: [/b][/h3]
We've modified a fight to feature SCP-377, which now not only enhances the encounter but also unlocks an additional mission for players to tackle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/b7c97e35baec1aacd456dece56ec70f8abbf28c6.png[/img]

This is just the first of many side missions we are planning to introduce. We are already working on more and invite you to join our Discord server where we post the most current progress updates. 

[h3]Happy gaming and see you in the next update![/h3]

notes.title: Update 0.4 "Strategic Enhancements" Now Available in "SCP: The Expedition"
notes.content:
[h3]Update 0.4 "[b]Strategic Enhancements[/b]" Now Available in [b]SCP: The Expedition[/b][/h3]

We are excited to announce the release of [b]update 0.4 "Strategic Enhancements"[/b] for [b]SCP: The Expedition[/b]. This update brings two significant changes aimed at improving gameplay and adding depth to combat scenarios. 

[h2]Here’s what's new:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/7acdee9dfb3c504c86763d48853690dc5773df8c.png[/img]
[h3]Improved Optimization[/h3]Following the changes made to the camera work, a performance drop was noted across many locations. However, with the latest fixes in the rendering of the game world, we've managed to increase performance by up to 10% during the most demanding moments! This enhancement ensures a smoother experience across all areas of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/9da4c2913b39d72f3e260711314d56ce58a38147.png[/img]
[h3]New Types of Human Enemies[/h3]We're introducing a variety of Chaos Insurgency agents to make the battles more intriguing. In the current version of the game, you will encounter the following types of enemies: [list]
[*]Chaos Operative
[*]Chaos Grenadier
[*]Chaos Precision Eliminator
[*]Chaos Suicide Insurgent
[*]Chaos Heavy Enforcer
[/list]This diversification is designed to challenge players to adapt their strategies and provides a richer combat experience.

Although the list of changes in this version is brief, we want to inform you that these implemented changes will facilitate the introduction of more enemy types in the future! We've completed the prototyping phase for SCP-337, whose prototype version can be seen in the gif below. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/7d62d3127d9430b44f4d53035652dc6d3a1387af.gif[/img]

Additionally, we're developing mechanics for other SCPs that players will be able to confront. We're not resting on our laurels and are already excitedly working on a new map and side missions. However, they will require a bit more time before they're ready. 

[h3]Happy Easter, and see you in 2 weeks with the new update![/h3]

tags.feature: Improved Optimization
New Types of Human Enemies

notes.title: Hotfix 0.3.1 for SCP: The Expedition is now available!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of hotfix 0.3.1, introducing crucial improvements to [b]SCP: The Expedition[/b]. Here's what has been addressed:

- [b]Enhanced Mission Loading:[/b] We have increased the speed of scene loading. By optimizing the loading process during mission briefings, transitioning into action is now quicker and smoother.

- [b]Fixed Issue with Operation Green Whisper:[/b] We've addressed a rare issue where attempting to load a game save that had already started the [b]Operation Green Whisper[/b] mission would cause infinite loading. With this fix, the mission should now load seamlessly, allowing all players to fully enjoy the gameplay experience.

[h3]Update Size Information[/h3]
We understand that the size of the latest hotfix update 0.3.1 may appear large to some players. We would like to clarify that this is due to our ongoing efforts to improve [b]SCP: The Expedition[/b]. Currently, the game files are not fully optimized, which results in a larger update size.

However, we are aware of this issue and are actively working not only on enhancing and developing the game but also on optimizing the source code. Our goal is to make changes to the game's structure so that future updates will not require downloading such large files.

Thank you for your understanding and patience. Your support is invaluable to us and motivates us to continue our work, making [b]SCP: The Expedition[/b] even better.

notes.title: Update 0.3 New Horizons Now Available in SCP: The Expedition!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/5a6f5dcdbf43203bd0e2b561ea67ddd80e7b5212.png[/img]
[b][h2]Dear explorers of the SCP Foundation mysteries, [/h2][/b]
we're thrilled to announce the release of the latest 0.3 [b]New Horizons[/b] update, which brings fresh changes and improvements to the world of [b]SCP: The Expedition[/b]. Here’s what's new for you in this exciting update:

[h3]Enhanced Weapon System:[/h3] Our team has worked diligently on expanding the arsenal available to your agents. With this update, we’ve introduced three new types of weapons, which not only increase your tactical possibilities but also add a new depth to combat strategies. Remember, the weapon system is still evolving, and in the near future, we will enable the upgrading of owned weapons.

[h3]Increased Character Speed:[/h3] Responding to player feedback, we've increased the movement speed of your agents by 30%. Now, exploration and responses to threats will be even more dynamic and smooth.

[h3]New Animations and Camera Work:[/h3] Exploration of the game world and combat have gained a new dimension with the introduction of new animations, making unit movements more realistic and dynamic. Additionally, we've revamped the camera work to better adapt to player needs:
- During exploration, the camera now defaults to a position closer to the agents, providing a better view of the surroundings.
- In combat, we added the ability to move the camera using the WASD keys, giving greater control over the battlefield.
- We also improved the smoothness of camera movement during zooming, making every detail of the game world even more visible.

[h3]Improvements and Additions:[/h3] We’ve enhanced the appearance of terrains in all missions, adding new elements to discover and interesting items that will enrich your adventure. For detail lovers, we’ve also introduced the sound of Ivy's growth, as well as fixed the display of grenade descriptions and other objects.

[h3]In the coming weeks, we are not resting on our laurels![/h3] Our team is currently working on a new enemy behavior system. The aim of these changes is to introduce greater diversity into combat by adding new types of enemies. This exciting innovation will appear in the next update, scheduled for two weeks from now.

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us and inspires us to continuously develop [b]SCP: The Expedition[/b]. See you in the game!

notes.title: New Update "SCP: The Expedition" v0.2 - Steam Achievements, Bug Fixes, and More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/83218fdcd714c597e87536dff4360190e8c81df4.png[/img]

[h2][b]Dear Players![/b][/h2]

We are thrilled to announce the release of [b]update v0.2 [/b]for our turn-based strategy game, "SCP: The Expedition". This update brings a host of changes and additions that you have been eagerly waiting for, enriching your gaming experience even further. Here are the key highlights of the update:

[h3]Steam Achievements:[/h3] We're excited to introduce a complete set of Steam achievements that will offer you additional challenges and goals to achieve during your adventure. You can find the entire list of new achievements [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2329910/achievements]here[/url].

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3] Our team has been tirelessly working to eliminate any bugs that might have affected the smoothness and enjoyment of your gameplay. Thanks to your reports, we have been able to identify and fix numerous issues, ensuring that your expedition will now be smoother and more seamless.

[h3]Database UI:[/h3] A major addition is the implementation of the Database UI - a user interface for the game's lore, displaying various reports, orders, and more. This tool will significantly improve your ability to navigate the world of the game and aid in strategizing.

We know that many of you were looking forward to other features we had previously announced. We intended to include them in this update, but we decided that maintaining the promised regularity of updates is our priority. We believe that this decision will allow for better game balancing and provide you, the players, with a more stable and satisfying experience.

[h3]What's Next?[/h3] Over the next few days, we plan to add the remaining fixes and enhancements. These will be implemented as soon as they are thoroughly prepared and tested. Our goal is to ensure that every aspect of "SCP: The Expedition" is as perfect as possible for our gaming community.

For now, we wish you happy achievement hunting and unforgettable adventures in the SCP world. Your support and passion are our constant inspiration to continue working and improving "SCP: The Expedition".

[i][h3]LUXO Interactive[/h3][/i]

notes.title: Join the Latest Playtest for "SCP: The Expedition" – Explore New Frontiers!
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings, explorers and SCP Foundation agents![/h1]

We're thrilled to announce an exclusive playtesting phase for [b]SCP: The Expedition[/b], and we're [b]inviting YOU[/b] to dive into uncharted territories before anyone else. This playtest introduces a brand-new region teeming with mysteries, novel items, and challenges that will test the mettle of your Mobile Task Force.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/f679378672fc0219284556310797ac0187a867df.png[/img]

[h2]What’s New?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Explore a Newly Unveiled Region[/b]: Venture into a previously unexplored area, where the unknown lurks around every corner. What secrets will you uncover?
[*] [b]New Items and Gear[/b]: Discover and utilize a variety of new items, including innovative grenades and equipment, to aid in your mission. How will these change your strategy?
[*] [b]Team Composition & Skill Development[/b]: The beta allows for more nuanced team building and agent skill enhancement. Tailor your team to face the evolving challenges head-on.
[*] [b]Enhanced Gameplay Experience[/b]: With the introduction of these new features, your strategic decisions matter more than ever. Prepare to adapt and overcome in the face of adversity.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739260/

[h3]We Want to Hear From You![/h3]
Your feedback is invaluable to us. As you explore, fight, and strategize, we encourage you to share your gameplay experiences on social media. Tag us, use the hashtag #SCPTheExpeditionPlaytest, and let the community know how you're faring against the Chaos Insurgency and the SCPs you encounter. We’re closely monitoring posts about the game and are eager to hear your insights, suggestions, and discoveries.

[h3]How to Participate:
[/h3]To join the playtest, simply click on the "[i]Request Access[/i]" button on our Steam page. Spots are limited, so enlist your task force and prepare for an expedition like no other.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739260/

[h3]Share Your Journey:[/h3]
Remember, your playthroughs, strategies, and encounters can be shared across your favorite social media platforms. Not only does this help us improve the game, but it also builds our community and allows you to be a part of the game's development journey.

Don't miss this unique opportunity to shape the future of [b]SCP: The Expedition[/b]. The anomalies await, agent. Are you ready to embark on this perilous expedition?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/6e6187b1b0176624fd6ef1e14ac4c899b5c360d2.png[/img]

[h3]Latest Updates in Version v0.1.4:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]New Throwable Grenades[/b]: Explore an arsenal of grenades, each with unique combat modifiers to enhance your tactical options.
[*] [b]HP Bars & Combat UI Overhaul[/b]: Enjoy improved visibility with revamped HP bars and a more optimized combat interface.
[*] [b]Enemy AI Enhancements[/b]: Encounter smarter enemies with improved actions during combat for a challenging gameplay experience.
[*] [b]UI & Usability Improvements[/b]:
[list]
[*] A sleek, new cursor design for better navigation.
[*] Enhanced equipment screen for easier gear management.
[*] Revamped main menu environment and gameplay UI screens for an immersive experience.
[*] Introduction of a combat summary log to track your battle achievements and strategies.
[*] Added functionality to use the keyboard for navigating main menu screens, enhancing accessibility.
[/list][*] [b]Talent System & Agent Development[/b]: Unveil a new talents system, allowing for deeper agent customization and skill progression.
[*] [b]Agent Recruitment & Management[/b]: New features to hire agents after creating your MTF unit, adding depth to team building.
[*] [b]Prologue & Gameplay Expansion[/b]:[list]
[*] Extended prologue area with an added final battle for a grand introduction to the game.
[*] More detailed stats display to strategize your missions better.
[*] Increased variety in available agents, ensuring no two teams are alike.[/list][*] [b]Equipment & Weapons[/b]:[list]
[*] The team now has access to a defibrillator, introducing a strategic element to combat scenarios. Deciding when and on whom to use it adds a critical layer to your mission planning and resource management.
[*] A new weapon selection screen (currently in preview and temporarily locked) gives a sneak peek at future customization options.[/list][*] [b]Tutorials & Guides[/b]: Added new tutorials to ease new players into the game's mechanics and universe.
[*] [b]Game Balance & Bug Fixes[/b]: Improved game balance for a fair yet challenging experience. Fixed known bugs (while embracing the charm of introducing new ones).
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2329910/SCP_The_Expedition/

[h3]Don’t miss out on the action! Add [b]SCP: The Expedition[/b] to your Steam wishlist now and stay updated on all the latest developments and release information. Be the first to embark on new expeditions and uncover the secrets of the SCP universe. Your adventure begins here.[/h3]

notes.title: What's New in SCP: The Expedition - Demo Update
notes.content:
[h2]What's New in SCP: The Expedition - Demo Update[/h2]
[h3]v0.1.2:24[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/3c0651171017ec36e3ff68565807dea0048a457a.png[/img]

[h3]We've been hard at work making "SCP: The Expedition" an even more immersive and engaging experience for all our brave explorers. Here's a glimpse of the major enhancements you'll find in the latest demo update:[/h3]

[h2]Expanded Playable Area: [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/26453a01a41d5e660e712bea503c86c932e5c22e.png[/img]
Venture further into the unknown with an extended map. Discover new secrets, face new challenges, and uncover more of what lies beyond.

[h2]Cover System: [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/cd00ea2450597a7fbfe29e952d2db17080105645.png[/img]
Take strategic advantage in combat with the new cover system, allowing agents to duck behind obstacles for protection.

[h2]Vegetation Shaders and Camera Obstacle Avoidance: [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/254215b8ddcba37aaeb0e4a0f053680dae54c76b.jpg[/img]
Never lose sight of your agents again, thanks to our new shaders that gently dissolve foliage that would otherwise block your view. Moreover, our camera now smartly navigates around obstructions, ensuring you have the best view of the action at all times.

[h2]New Story Elements: [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/4664e5589ef515f119ae073c776b4bdb8be2575c.jpg[/img]
Engage with fresh narrative content, including a new character, deeper dialogues, and a trove of collectibles to enrich your journey.

[h2]Main Menu & Expedition Prep UI: [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/904ccb3cebc394ee72991686d73c4855bbaf518d.jpg[/img]
Dive into a more intuitive start to your adventures with our improved main menu and expedition setup screens.

[h2]Inventory UI Redesign: [/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/c3c15481c37aa7ab4fec287ea2ae8f5e345fc94c.jpg[/img]
Managing your gear is smoother than ever with our overhauled inventory interface – sleek and easy to navigate.

And that's just the beginning! We've also implemented a series of optimizations and enhancements across the demo.

[b]New Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] New battles to challenge your tactical skills
[*] A new type of pickable object: scrap 
[*] New collectibles scattered throughout the game for you to discover
[*] New story elements, including a character that deepens the plot
[*] New tutorials to better acquaint you with game mechanics
[/list]

[b]Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved Red Lake's surface visuals for a more realistic environment
[*] Optimized game files for smoother performance and faster load times
[*] Enhanced protection of expedition areas to maintain gameplay balance
[*] Improved various UI elements for clearer and more intuitive interaction
[*] Improved dialogue display to ensure better storytelling immersion
[*] Upgraded the weapons system for more engaging combat experiences
[*] Improved enemy AI system for smarter and more challenging opponents
[*] Enhanced character and NPC animations for more lifelike movements
[*] Improved briefing UI with options for transcription and video skipping
[/list]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated the exploration soundtrack to enhance the atmospheric feel
[*] Redesigned cursor hint UI for better gameplay guidance
[*] Changed the game logo for a fresh and updated look
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed agents' avoidance issues to prevent them from blocking each other
[*] Fixed interaction UI issues to ensure a seamless experience
[*] Fixed the issue with highlighting agents/enemies 
[*] Rebalanced enemies' HP for a fairer combat difficulty
[*] Fixed the issue with during skipping dialogues
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/81cf49b9e79992f9c2a685f24952c28bdddde3c5.jpg[/img]
We're thrilled to roll out these updates and can't wait for you to dive back into the world of "SCP: The Expedition." As always, your feedback is invaluable, so keep it coming as we continue to shape the game!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/5aba8b9d66a764e0ee5cf362d973029091991ed0.png[/img]
Join us on our journey and become a crucial part of "SCP: The Expedition" development. Your support on [url=https://www.patreon.com/LUXOInteractive]Patreon [/url]helps us bring more content, features, and polish to the game. Become a patron today and gain access to exclusive updates, behind-the-scenes looks, and a chance to be involved in the game's creation. Your involvement makes all the difference. Support us at patreon.com and let's craft an unforgettable experience together!

Stay vigilant, agents!

notes.title: SCP: The Expedition Demo - Combat Mode Overview- Devlog 2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43795369/951dbc8b17e9b2fee4b93317c4b009d1e8f546cc.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, fellow explorers and fans of the SCP universe![/h2]

We are thrilled to provide another insightful update on our exciting project, "SCP: The Expedition." This time around, we will be delving deep into the innovative combat system that has been integrated into our game, with this post acting as a comprehensive guide to this unique feature.

Before we start, it's essential to mention that this blog is specifically related to the demo version of SCP: The Expedition, and we strongly suggest checking out our concise video material, showcasing particular elements of the game for a more immersive understanding.

[previewyoutube=snPU3WKWMuA;full][/previewyoutube]

The bedrock of our game’s combat is its turn-based system. This means that characters, or team members, take turns to carry out their actions, with each member being allocated a set number of action points for their turn. As the game progresses, the number of action points available to your agents will vary, making strategy and careful planning a pivotal aspect of gameplay.

For the sake of simplicity in the prologue, all agents currently wield the same weapon. However, rest assured that the full version of the game offers a veritable arsenal, including a diverse range of weapons, grenades, medkits, and other special items to cater to every strategic approach.

In terms of the actual gameplay, each character has the option to perform various tasks, depending on their skills and equipment. Actions may include altering their position on the map to achieve a clear shot, or to prepare for an impending attack. As such, maintaining an awareness of your environment and potential obstacles becomes crucial in ensuring the efficient use of action points and increasing the chances of victory.

Once a suitable position has been secured, agents can proceed to attack. If enemies are bunched up or strategically hidden behind an obstacle, employing a grenade may be the best option due to its area damage effect.

Should your agent sustain injuries, items like medkits can be used to restore their health. This ensures they remain combat-ready and reinforces the significance of maintaining a well-stocked inventory.

The variety of actions during a turn are dictated by the cost of each action, with more complex tasks requiring more action points. During combat, navigation between team members is smooth and intuitive, using either the TAB key or a simple mouse click.

Your turn comes to an end when all your agents exhaust their action points, at which point you can click the "Next turn" button, giving your adversaries their turn to move.

In addition to the above, our game also allows the use of SCP (Secure, Contain, Protect) entities during combat. These entities can give you an edge in battle, introducing an extra layer of complexity and fun to your combat experience.

This wraps up our blog post dedicated to the combat system in our game, "SCP: The Expedition." We genuinely hope you find it intriguing and, as always, we eagerly anticipate your feedback. Thank you immensely for your continued support, and do stay tuned for the next devlog!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2329910/SCP_The_Expedition?utm_source=scpe_event&utm_campaign=devlog2

Your support means the world to us! If you're as thrilled about SCP: The Expedition as we are, we kindly invite you to add the game to your wishlist and subscribe to our channel for the latest updates. For more behind-the-scenes peeks, exclusive content, and to become part of our rapidly growing community, be sure to join us on Discord. Together, we can embark on this incredible expedition and unfold the mysteries of the SCP universe. See you there!
